note: Proposals for Cameron to trim. Every test asserts the expected result and is RED first because its module does not exist yet. A nonzero diff in N2.G6.2 to N2.G6.5 is a found lever, reported as a finding, not a lab failure.

goals.text: Generate the same square of chunks twice in the same order and check the two worlds are identical, so any later difference can be blamed on the order.
goals.kill: a nonzero diff between two identical-order runs means thread noise; serialise loads before reading any order result

goals.text: Load one 2x2 square of chunks forward and then backward in fresh worlds and count every block that differs.
goals.kill: zero differing blocks over the 4 full chunks and every readable ring chunk kills L1 for this square; run the other two squares before retiring it

goals.text: Build a chunk next to a finished one after changing blocks along the shared edge, and see if the new chunk's edge blocks change.
goals.kill: new chunk and old chunk identical to a no-edit control outside the edited cells kills L2

goals.text: Count the diamond ore blocks that differ between two build orders and say where they sit relative to the chunk edge.
goals.kill: zero diamond difference in every order across 3 squares kills the more-diamond aim even if other blocks differ

goals.text: Wait two minutes after boot, then build the square, and compare it with a square built at once.
goals.kill: zero differing blocks kills time or tick state as a lever

goals.text: Check that the area near spawn the route planner reads is the same whichever way the chunks were built.
goals.kill: if the route area differs between orders, N2.G4 must record the build order with its terrain; if identical the planner may ignore order
